About Momentum Makers

Supporting companies
to Trade globally.

Momentum Makers is a commodity trading company focused primarily on palm oil, with supporting activity across coal and nickel. We work across the supply chain, connecting source markets in Asia with industrial buyers and distribution channels across Africa and Europe. Our commercial structure allows us to act as both principal trader and trade intermediary, depending on the requirements of each transaction.

Commodity Trading

Our Core
Trading Portfolios

Momentum Makers places palm oil at the centre of its trading activity, supported by selected portfolios in coal and nickel. Each portfolio is structured around supply relationships, logistics coordination, and buyer networks across target markets.

01 — Core Commodity
Palm Oil
Indonesia · Southeast Asia

Palm oil is the main focus of Momentum Makers’ trading activity. The company sources and trades crude palm oil (CPO) and refined palm oil products from Indonesia and key Southeast Asian production regions, connecting established supply channels with buyers across Africa and Europe.

Our work covers bulk procurement from mills and plantation networks, logistics coordination including tankage and maritime freight, and commercial delivery to food manufacturers, refineries, and industrial processors. Momentum Makers operates with awareness of the quality standards and certification frameworks relevant to palm oil trade.

02 — Supporting Commodity
Coal
Indonesia · Asia Pacific

Momentum Makers supports selected coal trading opportunities, including thermal and coking coal sourced primarily from Indonesia and the broader Asia Pacific region. This activity is handled through structured commercial coordination, with a focus on reliable supply, clear terms, and disciplined execution.

Our role may include procurement support, freight coordination, documentation, and delivery planning for industrial buyers, utilities, and international traders across Africa and Europe.

03 — Supporting Commodity
Nickel
Indonesia · Asia Pacific

Momentum Makers also supports selected nickel-related transactions connected to Indonesian supply channels. This includes nickel ore and intermediate products used across stainless steel production and battery materials supply chains.

The company’s role is focused on connecting qualified counterparties, supporting commercial coordination, and facilitating access to supply where the transaction structure and buyer requirements are aligned.

Commercial Services

Strategy &
Execution

Momentum Makers provides a structured commercial framework that supports the full lifecycle of a commodity transaction — from market positioning and counterparty identification, through execution and logistics, to final delivery and settlement. Our team operates with the discipline and precision required of a serious international trading company.

Trade
Structuring
End-to-end transaction management including counterparty negotiation, contract structuring, and commercial term definition across FOB, CIF, and DAP delivery models.
Market
Representation
Defining and managing how your company is presented to buyers, suppliers, financiers, and institutional partners across international commodity markets.
Logistics &
Supply Chain
Coordination of freight, tankage, port operations, and cross-border documentation to ensure reliable, on-time delivery from source point to final destination.
Dedicated Desk

Energy
Trading

Momentum Makers supports commodity transactions through direct trading and third-party brokerage, depending on the nature and structure of each deal. While palm oil remains the company’s core focus, our commercial framework also supports selected energy and industrial commodity opportunities.

As a principal trader, Momentum Makers sources commodities directly from producers and sells to qualified buyers on agreed commercial terms. As a broker and intermediary, Momentum Makers facilitates transactions between producers, traders, and buyers where our regional network and market intelligence create measurable commercial value.

Our trading activity is anchored in the Asia-to-Africa corridor, with coverage extending into European markets. Momentum Makers brings knowledge of source market dynamics, freight economics, and buyer requirements to every transaction it participates in.

01
Direct
Trading
Momentum Makers acts as principal, procuring energy commodities from producers and selling directly to industrial buyers, utilities, and international traders on FOB or CIF terms.
02
Trade
Brokerage
Where Momentum Makers does not take title, we connect qualified buyers and sellers, structuring deals and managing execution on a fee or commission basis using our established counterparty network.
03
Market
Intelligence
Our regional presence in Asia and Africa provides real-time visibility into palm oil supply availability, pricing trends, and logistical constraints — enabling well-timed, informed trade decisions.
04
Logistics
Coordination
From port nomination and freight booking to discharge supervision and documentation, Momentum Makers manages the physical execution of commodity trades from source to destination.
